card.name: Digits inside long numbers
card.fires_on: Single digits, decimal points or hyphens in the middle of a multi-digit number, such as a dose, percentage, count or registry number. It fires before the number is finished.

modes.example: FEMA’s share is 75 percent of the total $9,233,0<<6>>5 estimated cost of the reconstruction project.
